transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Thank you for being here for our final coordination meeting before I approve the red-carpet operating protocol. As it stands, the draft places the carpet in the Main Plaza, uses the south drive for guest drop-off, allows a two-meter public lane, and permits a mixed live-and-still press pool. Before I give my binding approval, I need each of you — permits, security, accessibility, and publicity — to report any operational requirements or concerns you have with this setup. Let's go around the table.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical permits issue. I received the city event permit after the draft packet was circulated, and it conflicts with the current plan in several ways. The permit authorizes the red carpet only in the East Arcade — not the Main Plaza. It requires a 2.4-meter clear pedestrian lane, not the two meters in the draft. And it permits the adjacent public walkway to be closed from 5:30 PM to 9:30 PM. I hadn't uploaded it yet because the city sent the signed PDF to the festival's general permits mailbox rather than to me directly, so I only just retrieved it.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical security concern. During my walk-through, I found that guest vehicles must use the North Service Court, not the south drive. The North Service Court only allows one vehicle to unload at a time without blocking the emergency access route. I recorded this in my shift log but hadn't yet circulated it to production. This directly conflicts with the draft protocol's use of the south drive for guest drop-off, and the single-vehicle limitation will create significant delays and a potential safety hazard if not addressed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have an accessibility requirement to report. During my accessibility inspection, I confirmed that the usable step-free guest route is through the West Entrance, not the Main Plaza as the draft assumes. A portable ramp needs to be deployed before arrivals, and a 1.8-meter clear route must be maintained to the accessible press position. The venue's facilities contact sent this confirmation directly to me. This is critical because the draft protocol's placement of the carpet in the Main Plaza doesn't account for the step-free route, and any final plan must ensure the accessible route from the West Entrance is integrated into the carpet layout, drop-off flow, and press positioning.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a publicity requirement to report. This afternoon I reviewed the lead actor's signed publicity rider with the distributor. It permits still photography at the arrival but prohibits live video coverage of the arrival. Additionally, the approved arrival images may be released at exactly 7:15 PM. This directly conflicts with the draft protocol's allowance of a mixed live-and-still press pool, since live video coverage of the arrival is not permitted. I'm currently waiting for the distributor's written email before I update the press brief, but I wanted to flag this now so it's on record before the protocol is approved.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.accessible_route: West Entrance, integrated into carpet layout, drop-off flow, and press positioning
decisions.arrival_coverage: still photography only; no live video

commitments.detail: Red-carpet zone relocated from Main Plaza to East Arcade per city event permit.
Guest drop-off moved from south drive to North Service Court with single-vehicle unloading sequence to avoid blocking emergency access.
Pedestrian clear lane widened from 2.0m to 2.4m per city permit requirement.

Accessible step-free route via West Entrance integrated into carpet layout, drop-off flow, and press positioning; portable ramp to be deployed before arrivals with 1.8m clear route maintained to accessible press position.
Press pool changed from mixed live-and-still to still photography only; live video coverage of arrival prohibited per lead actor's publicity rider.
Approved arrival images may be released at exactly 7:15 PM per publicity rider.
Obtain distributor's written email confirming the publicity rider terms before final press brief is issued.
Upload the signed city event permit PDF to the production shared drive for record.
